checks.name: identical_duplicate_shipment_id
checks.action: Keep one copy of each identical shipment id.

checks.name: conflicting_duplicate_shipment_id
checks.action: Quarantine every row when the same shipment id has different values.

checks.name: unknown_port
checks.action: Quarantine the shipment. The port code is not in the port file.

checks.name: noncanonical_status
checks.action: Map delivered to DELIVERED, Complete and COMPLETED to COMPLETED, blank and N/A to UNKNOWN.

checks.name: noncanonical_cargo
checks.action: Strip and map cargo to one canonical label. Leave a blank cargo null.

checks.name: zero_container_count
checks.action: Flag and keep the raw value.

checks.name: extreme_container_count
checks.action: Flag and keep the raw value. The model clips this feature at 40.

checks.name: missing_actual_timestamps
checks.action: Keep both timestamps null. Do not impute them.

checks.name: missing_port_country
checks.action: Flag the blank country. Do not fill a value that is not in the file.

checks.name: conflicting_event_id
checks.action: Quarantine every row with that event id. Do not pick a winner.

checks.name: blank_event_type
checks.action: Keep the row and store a null event type.

checks.name: sentinel_vessel
checks.action: Flag and keep the event. The vessel is not on a shipment.
